fact: Benin issues digital certificates for authentication and digital signature (PKI) and runs a TrustedX remote authentication and e-signature platform; more than 15.7 million digital authentications were made by ANIP via X-Road, with 19 public services linked to the RNPP.
title: Aspects pragmatiques de la réforme juridique de l'état des personnes épousant l'ère du numérique : l'expérience du Bénin
